jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: The company website needed a rebuild and a new CMS, so the team could manage content themselves instead of sending a developer a ticket. I took that on and, alongside it, contributed to the internal ERP system the company's daily operations rely on.

jobs.title: Bachelor Thesis
jobs.description: How far can a framework built for static sites go? To find out, I built a video streaming application with Astro as a Progressive Web App and tested how it handles dynamic functionality and real-time features, and where that stops working.

jobs.title: Internship Semester
jobs.description: Storybook was my starting point, integrated into a live client project. Next came an internal theme generator for the Angular Material library, and for the rest of the semester I helped build a new customer portal for an enterprise client.
